candidate.content: Official log-viewer documentation contains a single sample record in its format configuration.
candidate.license_search_scope: Root license/notice filenames, root README, package license field and repository license metadata. No comprehensive legal or nested-directory licensing determination is claimed.
candidate.decision: Do not select or redistribute the sample as a benchmark input unless reusable rights are established. Public visibility alone is not a license.

protocol_clarification: The original protocol permits a documented constructed-input fallback after unsuccessful suitable-public-input search. The earlier preparation's no-manufacture wording was a conservative candidate decision, not an amendment prohibiting that fallback. Any fallback needs a separate explicit input/generation record, independent verifier, pre-inference freeze and separate constructed-input reporting.
